correctness_argument.evaluation: The input still evaluates once through InListExpr. The existing floating filter stores values already computed by constant-list construction. No new SQL expression is stored or reevaluated during lookup.
correctness_argument.constant_casts: The new comparison also supports cached constant expressions other than Literal. It compares their cached values instead of executing those expressions again.
correctness_argument.semantics: Arrow floating equality and the native OrderedFloat hash keys use IEEE bit equality. The existing Spark normalizer remains responsible for canonical zero and NaN representations. Arrow Kleene OR/NOT preserve three-valued logic.
correctness_argument.fallback: For non-all-NULL lists, short floating scalar arrays, primitive arrays below 8192 rows, and empty or longer lists use the unchanged hash body. All-NULL numeric lists keep the accepted NULL filter selection. Existing dictionary recursion makes the decision from the dictionary value array length, not its key count. counter_repeat.method: Four fresh processes per variant, balanced order, isolated profiles chosen from the largest sequential-matrix increases and the slower scalar controls. No source or harness changes.

native_repeat.method: Same frozen native harness in four fresh processes per before/after variant, balanced order. All 180 profiles repeated because this harness has no per-profile selector.

query_performance.method: Separate planning-only and execution-only counters, CPU 2, no retained output, four fresh processes per case and variant, balanced order, two warmups and nine samples. All compilation and correctness work finished before timing.

limitations: Nullable scalar controls take row zero as their scalar input, which is NULL. They exercise the existing scalar-NULL shortcut rather than calling a static filter.
The 256-row FLOAT all-NULL increase reproduces in the full sequential matrix. It was not measured with an isolated per-profile harness.
Unchanged generic filter source and nearly unchanged whole-process instructions do not establish the cause of the Utf8 latency increase. No new code-layout experiment was run in this slice.
The candidate is evaluated on the optional runtime. The default project build is unchanged.
Existing Spark normalization, its allocation cost, planning overhead and 331 raw Spark differences remain.
Elapsed timings vary between processes and sessions. Use within-series comparisons, not subtraction of historical gaps, to attribute gains.
The 8192-row cutoff is conservative and is not optimized for every CPU, batch size or distribution.
Native hardware counters include setup and teardown; SQL counters isolate the selected phase. One pinned CPU does not establish multicore scaling.
next_boundary: Keep the accepted NULL optimization. Further work on the floating-filter design needs to explain and remove its reproducible string and scalar penalties before reconsidering adoption; the small-array gains alone do not justify adding it.

import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path

    ids={r['id'].rsplit('_',1)[0] for r in rows if 'error' in r['changed_fields']}
    if not ids:continue
    assert all(r['changed_fields']==['error'] for r in rows if 'error' in r['changed_fields'])
    old=load(prior/f'after-{name}.json')
    cases.extend(c for c in old['cases'] if c['id'] in ids)
    expected.update({r['id']:r['actual'] for r in old['results'] if r['id'].rsplit('_',1)[0] in ids})
file=p/'diagnostic-cases.jsonl'
file.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(c)+'\n' for c in cases))
runs=[]

    for v in ['before','after']:
        out=p/f'diagnostic-{v}-{index}.json'
        command=[str(p/f'{v}-probe'),str(file),str(out),'--physical-plans']
        subprocess.run(command,check=True,capture_output=True)
        observations=[]
        for r in load(out)['results']:
            old=expected[r['id']];new=r['actual']
            assert {k:v for k,v in old.items() if k!='error'} == {k:v for k,v in new.items() if k!='error'},r['id']
            observations.append({'id':r['id'],'status':new['status'],'error':new.get('error'),'physical_plan_sha256':hashlib.sha256(new.get('physical_plan','').encode()).hexdigest()})
        runs.append({'variant':v,'index':index,'command':command,'capture_sha256':hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'observations':observations})
(p/'diagnostic-reruns.json').write_text(json.dumps(runs,indent=2)+'\n')
print(len(cases),'parallel-error queries rerun three times per variant, both ANSI modes; all fields except first-error text identical.')

import json, os, statistics, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent
out=p/'native-measurements'
out.mkdir()
base=os.environ.copy()
assert not any(k.startswith(('MALLOC_', 'GLIBC_', 'LD_PRELOAD', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_')) for k in base)
runs=[]
order=['before','after','reference','reference','after','before']*2
canonical=None
for index,variant in enumerate(order):
    capture=out/f'{index}-{variant}.json'
    command=['taskset','-c','2',str(p/f'{variant}-native-bench'),str(capture)]
    subprocess.run(command,check=True,env=base,timeout=120)
    rows=json.loads(capture.read_text())
    check=[{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='samples_ns'} for r in rows]
    if canonical is None:canonical=check
    else:assert check==canonical
    runs.append({'variant':variant,'index':index,'command':command,'results':rows})
    (p/'native-performance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'order':order,'runs':runs},indent=2)+'\n')
    print(index,variant,'complete',flush=True)
summary=[]
for position,case in enumerate(canonical):
    groups={v:[statistics.median(r['results'][position]['samples_ns']) for r in runs if r['variant']==v] for v in ['before','after','reference']}
    medians={v:statistics.median(x) for v,x in groups.items()}
    summary.append(case | {'process_medians_ns':groups,'medians_ns':medians,'change_pct':100*(medians['after']/medians['before']-1),'after_vs_reference_pct':100*(medians['after']/medians['reference']-1),'before_vs_reference_pct':100*(medians['before']/medians['reference']-1)})
(p/'native-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
for rows in [1,8,32,64,256,8192]:
    group=[r for r in summary if r['rows']==rows and r['list_length']<=3]
    print(rows,'rows, median/min/max percentage change:',*[round(x,2) for x in [statistics.median(r['change_pct'] for r in group),min(r['change_pct'] for r in group),max(r['change_pct'] for r in group)]],flush=True)

canonical=None
for index,variant in enumerate(order):
    capture=out/f'{index}-{variant}.json'
    command=['taskset','-c','2',str(p/f'{variant}-native-bench'),str(capture)]
    subprocess.run(command,check=True,env=base,timeout=120)
    rows=json.loads(capture.read_text())
    check=[{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='samples_ns'} for r in rows]
    if canonical is None:canonical=check
    else:assert check==canonical
    runs.append({'variant':variant,'index':index,'command':command,'results':rows})
    (p/'native-repeat-performance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'order':order,'runs':runs},indent=2)+'\n')
    print(index,variant,'complete',flush=True)
summary=[]
for position,case in enumerate(canonical):
    groups={v:[statistics.median(r['results'][position]['samples_ns']) for r in runs if r['variant']==v] for v in ['before','after']}
    medians={v:statistics.median(x) for v,x in groups.items()}
    summary.append(case | {'process_medians_ns':groups,'medians_ns':medians,'change_pct':100*(medians['after']/medians['before']-1)})
(p/'native-repeat-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
for rows in [1,8,32,64,256,8192]:
    group=[r for r in summary if r['rows']==rows and r['list_length']<=3]
    print(rows,'rows, median/min/max percentage change:',*[round(x,2) for x in [statistics.median(r['change_pct'] for r in group),min(r['change_pct'] for r in group),max(r['change_pct'] for r in group)]],flush=True)

import json
import os
import statistics
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
out = p / 'performance-reviewed'
out.mkdir()
controls = ['in_decimal_short_ansitrue', 'in_integer_ansitrue', 'in_f64_long_ansitrue', 'no_division_ansitrue']
targets = ['float_in_f32_ansitrue', 'float_in_f64_ansitrue', 'in_f64_nulls_ansitrue']
references = ['float_in_f32_ansitrue', 'float_in_f64_ansitrue']
canonical = {v: {r['id']: r for r in json.loads((p / f'{v}-subquery-check.json').read_text())['results']} for v in ['before', 'after', 'reference']}
base = os.environ.copy()
assert not any(k.startswith(('MALLOC_', 'GLIBC_', 'LD_PRELOAD', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_')) for k in base)
order = ['before', 'after', 'reference', 'reference', 'after', 'before'] * 2
experiments = [(v, i, references if v == 'reference' else controls + targets) for i, v in enumerate(order)]
runs = []
for variant, index, cases in experiments:
    for phase in ['planning', 'execution']:
        shift = index % len(cases)
        for case in cases[shift:] + cases[:shift]:
            directory = out / f'{index:02}-{variant}-{phase}-{case}'
            directory.mkdir()
            for name in ['control', 'ack']:
                os.mkfifo(directory / name)
            command = ['perf', 'stat', '--delay=-1', f'--control=fifo:{directory}/control,{directory}/ack', '--json-output', '-o', str(directory / 'counters.jsonl'), '-e', '{instructions:u,cycles:u},task-clock:u,context-switches:u,cpu-migrations:u,page-faults:u', '--', 'taskset', '-c', '2', str(p / f'{variant}-bench'), str(directory / 'capture.json'), 'subqueries', case]
            env = base | {'DECIMAL_BENCH_RETAIN': 'none', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_DIR': str(directory), 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_PHASE': phase}
            result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=180)
            capture = json.loads((directory / 'capture.json').read_text())
            assert len(capture['results']) == 1
            r = capture['results'][0]
            for field, value in canonical[variant][case].items():
                assert r[field] == value, (variant, case, field)
            assert r['retention'] == 'none' and r['retained_rows'] == 0
            counters = [json.loads(x) for x in (directory / 'counters.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if x.startswith('{')]
            assert len(counters) == 6 and all(x['pcnt-running'] == 100 for x in counters)
            assert result.stderr.count('Events enabled') == 1
            assert len(r['samples_ms']) == len(r['planning_samples_ms']) == 9
            samples = r['planning_samples_ms' if phase == 'planning' else 'samples_ms']
            runs.append({'variant': variant, 'phase': phase, 'index': index, 'case': case, 'command': command, 'capture': capture, 'counters': counters, 'median_ms': statistics.median(samples)})
    (p / 'performance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'order': order, 'controls': controls, 'targets': targets, 'runs': runs}, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(variant, index, 'complete', flush=True)


def stats(rows):
    medians = [r['median_ms'] for r in rows]
    instructions = [next(float(c['counter-value']) for c in r['counters'] if c['event'] == 'instructions:u') for r in rows]
    return {'processes': len(rows), 'median_ms': statistics.median(medians), 'process_medians_ms': medians, 'median_instructions': statistics.median(instructions), 'process_instructions': instructions}


summary = {}
for phase in ['planning', 'execution']:
    summary[phase] = {}
    for case in controls + targets:
        groups = {v: stats([r for r in runs if r['variant'] == v and r['case'] == case and r['phase'] == phase]) for v in ['before', 'after']}
        summary[phase][case] = groups | {'latency_change_pct': 100 * (groups['after']['median_ms'] / groups['before']['median_ms'] - 1), 'instruction_change_pct': 100 * (groups['after']['median_instructions'] / groups['before']['median_instructions'] - 1)}
        if case in references:
            reference = stats([r for r in runs if r['variant'] == 'reference' and r['case'] == case and r['phase'] == phase])
            summary[phase][case].update(reference=reference, after_vs_reference_latency_change_pct=100 * (groups['after']['median_ms'] / reference['median_ms'] - 1), after_vs_reference_instruction_change_pct=100 * (groups['after']['median_instructions'] / reference['median_instructions'] - 1))
    print(phase, summary[phase], flush=True)
(p / 'performance-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')

import difflib,hashlib,json,shutil,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent;n=p.parent/'float-short-in-58ce2ed/datafusion-physical-expr'
files={'native-in-list':'src/expressions/in_list.rs','native-primitive-filter':'src/expressions/in_list/primitive_filter.rs','native-strategy':'src/expressions/in_list/strategy.rs','native-array-filter':'src/expressions/in_list/array_static_filter.rs'}
patch=''
for key,rel in files.items():
 f=n/rel
 subprocess.run(['rustfmt','--edition','2024','--config','max_width=90,skip_children=true',str(f)],check=True)
 shutil.copy2(f,p/f'candidate-{f.name}')
 before=(p/f'before-source-{key}').read_text();after=f.read_text()
 if before==after:continue
 patch+='diff --git a/'+rel+' b/'+rel+'\n'+''.join(difflib.unified_diff(before.splitlines(True),after.splitlines(True),fromfile='a/'+rel,tofile='b/'+rel))
(p/'candidate.patch').write_text(patch)
s=p/'patch-check'
for key,rel in files.items():shutil.copyfile(p/f'before-source-{key}',s/rel)
subprocess.run(['git','apply',str(p/'candidate.patch')],cwd=s,check=True)
for rel in files.values():
 f=s/rel;assert f.read_bytes()==(p/f'candidate-{f.name}').read_bytes()
 subprocess.run(['rustfmt','--check','--edition','2024','--config','max_width=90,skip_children=true',str(f)],check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','apply','--reverse',str(p/'candidate.patch')],cwd=s,check=True)
for key,rel in files.items():assert (s/rel).read_bytes()==(p/f'before-source-{key}').read_bytes()
(p/'patch-check.json').write_text(json.dumps({'applies_exactly':True,'reverses_exactly':True,'rustfmt':True,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(patch.encode()).hexdigest()},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Refreshed patch and verified apply/reverse/formatting.')

import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
sha = lambda f: hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
sources = json.loads((p / 'initial-sources.json').read_text())
executables = json.loads((p / 'initial-executables.json').read_text())
overrides = {'Cargo.lock': p / 'build-Cargo.lock', 'native-primitive-filter': p / 'candidate-primitive_filter.rs', 'native-strategy': p / 'candidate-strategy.rs', 'native-array-filter': p / 'candidate-array_static_filter.rs'}
for key, record in sources.items():
    if key == 'physical-test-lock':
        assert not Path(record['path']).exists()
        continue
    expected = (p / 'candidate-in_list.rs') if key == 'native-in-list' else ((p / 'initial-native-test-lock') if key == 'native-test-lock' else overrides.get(key, p / f'before-source-{key}'))
    current = Path(record['path'])
    assert (current.exists() and current.read_bytes() == expected.read_bytes()) or (record['existed'] and current.exists() and sha(current) == record['sha256']) or (not record['existed'] and not current.exists()), key
    if record['existed']:
        assert sha(p / f'initial-{key}') == record['sha256'], key
for key, record in executables.items():
    expected = p / f'after-{key}'
    assert sha(record['path']) == sha(expected), key
    assert sha(p / f'initial-target-{key}') == record['sha256'], key

started_ns = time.time_ns()
restored = {'sources': {}, 'executables': {}}
for key, record in sources.items():
    file = Path(record['path'])
    if record['existed']:
        shutil.copyfile(p / f'initial-{key}', file)
        shutil.copymode(p / f'initial-{key}', file)
        stamp_ns = time.time_ns()
        os.utime(file, ns=(stamp_ns, stamp_ns))
        assert sha(file) == record['sha256']
        assert file.stat().st_mtime_ns >= started_ns
        restored['sources'][key] = {'sha256': sha(file), 'fresh_mtime': True}
    else:
        file.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        restored['sources'][key] = {'absent': True}
for key, record in executables.items():
    file = Path(record['path'])
    # Cargo sometimes links this path to an artifact in deps/. Unlink before
    # restoring so another artifact is never overwritten through the hardlink.
    file.unlink()
    shutil.copyfile(p / f'initial-target-{key}', file)
    file.chmod(0o755)
    assert sha(file) == record['sha256']
    restored['executables'][key] = {'sha256': sha(file), 'mode': '0755'}
(p / 'restoration.json').write_text(json.dumps(restored, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Restored all 42 sources/lockfiles and three executable slots.')
